segments.name: Biotherapeutics
segments.description: A clinical stage biotherapeutics company developing an oral delivery platform for biologics and drugs, pursuing partnerships with biopharmaceutical companies.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The company has not generated product revenue; it receives upfront payments and is eligible for milestones and royalties under collaboration and license agreements with biopharmaceutical partners.
revenueModel.evidence: We do not have any products approved for sale, and we have not yet generated any revenue from sales of a commercial product.
